title: Entreprenuerial Business Forecasting
modules: Methods Of Smoothing / Weighted Moving Average
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more sophisticated type of trend projection."
The moving average is a more sophisticated type of trend projection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act of predicting the future economic conditions on the basis of past and present information."
Business forecasting is an act of predicting the future economic conditions on the basis of past and present information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used only with historical data to predict future performance."
Time-series methods are used only with historical data to predict future performance.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when historical data on variables of interest are available-these methods are based on an analysis of historical data concerning the time series of the specific variable of interest."

Quantitative forecasting methods are used when historical data on variables of interest are available-these methods are based on an analysis of historical data concerning the time series of the specific variable of interest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a proactive and futuristic strategy aimed at providing estimated stock level to meet demand at a particular point in time."
Inventory forecasting in my opinion is a proactive and futuristic strategy aimed at providing estimated stock level to meet demand at a particular point in time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by the production team to develop production or purchase order triggers, quantities and safety stock levels."
The forecast is used by the production team to develop production or purchase order triggers, quantities and safety stock levels.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to ever-greater weighting given to the more recent historical periods."
Exponential smoothing refers to ever-greater weighting given to the more recent historical periods.
fib: ______ means historical data is more relevant to the forecast.
A low Alpha factor means historical data is more relevant to the forecast.
______ means the projection of further earnings.
Profit Forecasting means the projection of further earnings.

Excel is an accounting spreadsheet program that enables users to organize sales history data for forecasting.

Forecasting is an important aspect of the planning process of stock control.

Medium-Range Forecast otherwise refer to as intermediate forecast which spans from three months to three years.
